## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Describe the pain point or gap.

## Proposed Solution

How should this work? Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is the proposed solution better?

## Philosophy Alignment

Which principle from our [philosophy](docs/philosophy.md) does this support? (e.g., Modular Everything, Real Engineer Behavior, Open Source for All)

## Additional Context

Any other context, mockups, or references.
